measurementMethod: One fresh Node process per document; two adapter calls; latency excludes Node startup and file reading; 10ms process-RSS sampling includes worker/native allocations and both calls. RSS is not worker heap and sampling may miss peaks. resourceUsage maxRSS may be unavailable on Windows. No contents logged or stored in this report.
